what: growth ratio delta(0)/delta(1000) vs CAMB 2.0.5, after the tau_remaining fix (b7ba0b3)
verdict: Big improvement from the 5.6% at k=0.0959 before the fix, but NOT uniform: k=0.03 h/Mpc is still 4.45% off while k=0.1 is 0.1%. The residual is scale-dependent, so the hierarchy fix is necessary but not sufficient.
